question: The value of (2)/((sqrt{5)+sqrt{3})}+(3)/((sqrt{6)-sqrt{3})}+(1)/((sqrt{6)+sqrt{5})} is:
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Directly rationalize the denominators by identifying the difference of squares:

⇒ 2 / (√5 + √3) = √5 − √3 (since 5 − 3 = 2, cancelling the numerator)

⇒ 3 / (√6 − √3) = √6 + √3 (since 6 − 3 = 3, cancelling the numerator)

⇒ 1 / (√6 + √5) = √6 − √5 (since 6 − 5 = 1, cancelling the numerator)

⇒ Sum = (√5 − √3) + (√6 + √3) + (√6 − √5) = 2√6

**∴ The correct answer is 2√6.**
